verdict.rationale: OpenClaw ships a dedicated browser tool ("dedicated Chrome/Brave/Edge/Chromium profile that the agent controls") documented at tools/browser.md, plus release notes calling out 'live browser automation' as a shipped feature, matching navigate/click/log-in/extract use cases for a power user. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of login/extraction reliability and more granular documentation of specific actions (e.g., form-fill, multi-tab extraction) beyond the high-level description.
